name: index_repo
description: Index a GitHub repository's source code. Fetches files, parses ASTs, extracts symbols, and saves to local storage. Set JCODEMUNCH_USE_AI_SUMMARIES=false to disable AI summaries globally.

url.description: GitHub repository URL or owner/repo string

use_ai_summaries.description: Use AI to generate symbol summaries. Supports Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, MiniMax, and GLM-5 via env vars. When false, uses docstrings or signature fallback.

extra_ignore_patterns.description: Additional gitignore-style patterns to exclude from indexing (merged with JCODEMUNCH_EXTRA_IGNORE_PATTERNS env var)

incremental.description: When true and an existing index exists, only re-index changed files.
